items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Now, another thing, too, that not much is mentioned about Snooze that could sing to beat hell. And he was a marvelous violin player.

ctx.x: Of course, he was sick in the hospital and all that. I wondered if he did.
Now, another thing, too, that not much is mentioned about Snooze that could sing to beat hell. And he was a marvelous violin player. Did you know that, too, Johnny?
Somebody told me that once, but I never did.
